verdict: PASS within inspected composer, rules overlay, attachment popup and pill framebuffer scope; sequential capture discrepancy and unobserved notification/compositor appearance remain explicit

review_method.text_inspection: Five new unique originals were opened directly at original dimensions. The remaining 42 unique byte hashes match originals previously opened directly. Nine additional PNG files are exact duplicates; all 56 file contents are covered.

scope_findings: Both empty and conversation fixtures retain readable two-line drafts through the tested focus, Escape, reopen, disconnected Return and tab-roundtrip states.

Conversation composer uses a neutral dark field with an intact focus/idle outline; no green input fill is visible. Empty-chat drafts occupy the large empty composer area by design; this review does not mistake that for a transcript.
Project Rules title, placeholder, explanatory text and close control remain contained. The inactive Add Rule label is intentionally dim; no accessibility contrast certification is claimed.

Four menu-open full frame files visibly include Attach context, Files and Project folder; corresponding region-only images omit the floating popup. Popup closure is visible in the subsequent full frames.
The outside-dismiss captures show the full resting pill with intact contour, readable label and contained mascot. These images establish foreground shape only, not native desktop composition.

capture_discrepancies.finding: Rules input field height differs between the sequential full and region captures; text and panel content remain readable in both.
capture_discrepancies.classification: Sequential capture/layout difference, not an atomic comparison; no product defect established.

limitations: These are application framebuffer and region captures, not OS-presented desktop screenshots. They do not prove translucency, native blur, backdrop response, window stacking or desktop composition.
Region supplements omit floating popup regions; attachment popup appearance was assessed only in full-window framebuffer images.

Disconnected-send notifications are not visible in the reviewed images and may be outside the captured surface or hidden. State receipts prove the checks and zero transport attempts; this review does not qualify notification appearance.

Full-window and region captures are sequential and may differ in layout or redraw timing. The recorded Rules input-height discrepancy prevent a claim that every full frame is visually identical to its supplement.
Caret pixels and visible text corroborate the state assertions; screenshots alone do not prove input routing, cancellation semantics, absence of transport, or timing/performance guarantees.
No source edits, app queries, input, captures or launches were performed during this independent review.

capture_provenance.source_status_at_review: Retained source file; uncommitted in the owned harness worktree when independently inspected
capture_provenance.validation: All 28 receipts are complete, report exactly one full capture, preserve the same observed owner between full and region capture, match both output hashes, and report no region-reader error with zero retained handles.
capture_provenance.process: Resolve unique semantic companion owner; request redraw/swap; capture full framebuffer once; revalidate owner; optionally capture GPU regions. Readiness waits do not repeat input or screenshots.
capture_provenance.limitations: Full framebuffer retains popup layers; region supplement can omit them. Neither path proves native desktop blur/translucency.

prior_run_comparison.limit: This resolves the final-frame omission; static comparison does not establish why the earlier capture differed. Earlier originals and review remain preserved.
